recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-26890 source follow-up is needed unless the work group reopens the later FHIR-39635 event type policy.
issue_request: FHIR-26890 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested replacing the outdated statement that message.code carries a Coding identifying the event with text saying MessageHeader.event[x] identifies the event, and additionally recorded that MessageHeader.eventUri should become MessageHeader.eventCanonical with canonical type.
initial_application: The issue was applied by d64b767e8c, which changed source/messaging.html from the obsolete message.code wording to MessageHeader.event[x] and changed MessageHeader.event[x] from uri to canonical(EventDefinition). The current messaging page still contains the corrected sentence.
additional_context: MessageHeader is active in source/fhir.ini and the checked source/messageheader StructureDefinition is in current build scope. Later FHIR-39635, already represented on the combined branch, harmonized MessageHeader.event[x] and MessageDefinition.event[x] as Coding | uri | canonical(EventDefinition, SubscriptionTopic), so the current presence of both uri and canonical is later approved messaging work rather than a missed FHIR-26890 rollback.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already contains the requested Defining Events sentence, includes canonical event references, and reflects the later event type harmonization.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue harmonized MessageHeader.event[x] and MessageDefinition.event[x] as Coding|uri|canonical(EventDefinition|SubscriptionTopic), explaining the current uri plus canonical type list.
Implemented in the same historical commit as FHIR-39635 but concerns MessageDefinition.parent, not the FHIR-26890 wording or MessageHeader.event[x] type choice.
